title: Ultra-photorealistic vertical 9:16 close
prompt:
Ultra-photorealistic vertical 9:16 close-up smartphone selfie of an exceptionally beautiful adult Korean woman sitting inside a warm rustic open-air café. The camera is held at arm’s length and slightly above eye level, framing her from the top of her hair to the lower chest. Her face fills most of the upper half of the image while the shoulders, neckline, necklace and upper bodice remain clearly visible. Subtle front-camera wide-angle perspective, intimate natural social-media photo rather than a formal studio portrait.

She has a small refined oval face with softly rounded cheeks, a gently tapered V-shaped jawline, smooth delicate cheekbones and a short rounded chin. Large but believable dark-chocolate almond-shaped eyes, softly defined double eyelids, long separated eyelashes, fine brown eyeliner, natural lower lashes and bright realistic catchlights. Slim softly arched dark-brown eyebrows, a small straight nose with a narrow bridge and rounded tip, and naturally full coral-pink lips forming a gentle closed-mouth smile. Luminous warm-ivory complexion with subtle peach blush, faint natural pores, soft peach fuzz and restrained beauty-camera smoothing. A tiny beauty mark is visible on the cheek at frame-left, with a few subtle natural beauty marks on the upper chest. She looks directly into the camera with a warm, calm and quietly confident expression.

 leveraged Machine Context omitted.

Her hair is deep espresso brown, nearly black, cut into a voluminous shoulder-length layered lob. A deep side part creates lifted roots and a broad sweep across the forehead. Large soft blowout waves curve around both cheeks and jaw, with outward-feathered curls resting across the shoulders. Individual strands, fine flyaways and subtle warm-brown highlights in the daylight. Small round pearl stud earrings and a delicate fine gold necklace with an irregular sculptural gold pendant centered on her upper chest.

She wears an ivory-white halter dress made from lightweight vertically crinkled chiffon. Wide halter straps rise around the neck, leaving the shoulders and collarbones exposed. A very deep plunging V neckline, softly gathered fabric beneath the bust, fine vertical pleats, realistic lightweight drape and subtle fabric texture. The garment remains securely fitted and naturally structured.

Exact pose: her torso faces almost directly toward the camera with the shoulder at frame-right slightly closer to the lens. Her head stays level with the chin gently lowered. One arm extends toward the camera from frame-right to hold the unseen phone, creating natural selfie foreshortening; the other arm remains outside the lower crop. Maintain symmetrical facial proportions and direct eye contact.

Warm natural-wood café interior with exposed timber posts, wooden beams, dark polished flooring and an open wood-framed window at frame-left revealing bright green foliage. A rustic table, reusable drink bottles, broad tropical leaves, hanging exposed-bulb pendant lights and a colorful hand-painted wall artwork appear softly in the background. Keep the environment recognizable but visually secondary to the woman.

Soft diffused daylight enters from frame-left, producing even luminous facial exposure, delicate eye reflections and gentle highlights across the dark curls. Warm reflected light from the wooden interior fills the shadows. Natural white balance, soft contrast, realistic skin tone, restrained sharpening and mild depth of field. Sharpest focus on the eyes and face, with the café background gently softened.

Real photographic texture: fine skin pores around the nose and cheeks, subtle under-eye texture, natural lip lines, realistic iris detail, individual eyelashes, fine baby hairs at the hairline, believable chiffon fibers, authentic pearl and gold reflections, slight sensor grain and subtle lens falloff. Avoid an anime face, excessively enlarged eyes, plastic skin, extreme smoothing, exaggerated facial proportions, distorted neckline, malformed shoulders or arms, visible phone, extra fingers, heavy background blur, text, logo and watermark.
